eyebrow.zh: 装前体检 · 与 star 无关 · 单二进制

headline.zh:
装前一步
给 skill 包一个与 star 无关的风险分
headline.en:
Risk-score a skill bundle
before you install it

sub.zh: 单文件 Go 二进制静态扫 shell、hook、外联三类面，输出 LOW/MED/HIGH 判定与逐条 finding，HIGH 退出码 2 直接当装前闸门。
sub.en: A single Go binary statically scans the shell, hook, and outbound-network surfaces, prints a LOW/MED/HIGH verdict with per-rule findings, and exits 2 on HIGH to act as a pre-install gate.

title.zh: 与 star 数无关的风险分
title.en: A risk score orthogonal to stars

body.zh: 0-100 分聚合成 LOW/MED/HIGH，全程不读取 star 数；报告底部带一条 stars ≠ safe 提醒——41k star 的库照样能在安装那一刻 curl|sh。
body.en: Findings aggregate into a 0-100 score and a LOW/MED/HIGH level without ever reading star count; the report carries a stars ≠ safe reminder — a 41k-star repo can still curl|sh on install.

chips: › 报告带 stars ≠ safe 提示

title.zh: 三个确定性检测器，无 LLM

body.zh: shell、hook、network 三个纯函数检测器跑在已读入内存的文件上：shell 抓 curl|sh 与随包脚本，hook 抓 hooks.json 里的生命周期命令，network 抓外联调用。无 LLM、无联网、可逐条审计。
body.en: Three pure-function detectors — shell, hook, network — run over files already read into memory: shell catches curl|sh and shipped scripts, hook catches lifecycle commands in hooks.json, network catches outbound calls. No LLM, no network, auditable per rule.

body.zh: --fail-on {none|low|medium|high} 配置 CI 闸门阈值（默认 high，兼容 v0.1）；整体风险达到阈值时 skvet 退出码 2，直接塞进 CI 当装前闸门，不用自己解析输出。
body.en: --fail-on {none|low|medium|high} configures the CI gate threshold (default high, v0.1-compatible); skvet exits 2 when overall risk meets the threshold, dropping into CI as a pre-install gate with no output parsing.

chips: › 默认 high 兼容 v0.1

body.zh: 适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、Antigravity 的 skill 包形态——一家一家的签名注册表盖不住 trending 面。单文件 Go 二进制，无守护进程，除 git clone 不碰网络。
body.en: Applies to the skill-bundle shapes of Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity — a per-vendor signed registry doesn't cover the trending surface. Single Go binary, no daemon, no network beyond git clone.

chips: › 单文件 Go 二进制
› 除 git clone 不联网

headline.zh: 装前一步，把决定权拿回来
headline.en: Take the call back, before you install

sub.zh: 免费、开源、单二进制。skvet 只做报告，装不装的判断在你。
sub.en: Free, open-source, single binary. skvet reports — you decide.

tag.en: MIT open-source · a stars-orthogonal pre-install risk score
